title: Jodi No.1
desc: Partners in crime Jai and Veeru set their next target on a rich businessman, Rai Bahadur. Things turn hilarious when both of them fall for his daughters.

title: Tapasya
desc: Indu, eldest daughter of a sick man, falls for her father's doctor. But her lover's mother demands she abandon her family and place her in-laws above all else.

title: Gold
desc: Tapan Das managed India's hockey team after independence. He faces many challenges as he fights to lead the team to win an Olympic gold medal for the nation.

title: Akele Hum Akele Tum
desc: Rohit and Kiran, aspiring singers, fall in love and marry. But responsibilities weigh heavily, straining their bond until Kiran decides to leave, breaking Rohit's heart and dreams.

title: Bawaal
desc: A small-town boy falls in love with the most beautiful girl in town. He eventually gets married to her only because he realises that their marriage can help him climb the social ladder.

title: Trimurti
desc: Falsely accused and jailed, Satyadevi hopes her three sons will free her and avenge her. But she discovers they live separate lives and despise one another.

title: Mehbooba
desc: Singer Suraj takes shelter during a storm and feels an eerie familiarity. Memories of a woman named Ratna surface, pulling him into a mysterious, emotional journey of the past.

title: Khushboo
desc: Kusum and Brindavan marry as children, but are separated by a misunderstanding. Years later, fate reunites them, and they struggle to mend broken ties, rediscovering love and trust in each other.

title: Biwi Ho To Aisi
desc: Suraj secretly marries Shalu, a village belle, defying his domineering mother Kamla. To drive Shalu away, Kamla falsely accuses her of stealing jewellery and money.

title: Vivah - Journey From Engagment To Marriage
desc: Poonam, an orphan, is engaged to Prem from a wealthy family. Just two days before the wedding, her house catches fire, leaving her with first-degree burns.

title: Singh Saab The Great
desc: Singh Saab is an honest and responsible tax officer, but the cunning Bhoodev plots against him. To stand up for what is right, Singh uses a clever and unique plan to teach Bhoodev a strong lesson.

title: Uri - The Surgical Strike
desc: After a deadly terrorist attack in Uri, Major Vihaan Singh Shergill leads a covert operation to eliminate the terrorists responsible, executing a high-risk mission deep across the border.

title: Mrs. Chatterjee Vs Norway
desc: Debika Chatterjee fights Norwegian authorities to regain custody of her children, battling cultural bias and legal hurdles in a foreign land.

title: Khalnayak
desc: Inspector Ram arrests notorious criminal Ballu, but when Ballu escapes and ruins Ram's reputation, his fiancee Ganga sets a trap-only to face trouble when Ballu unexpectedly falls for her.
